notes.title: New update
notes.content: Hello Conservationists, I have removed all the houses on the map so it doesn’t feel so dead but the farms and barns are still there.  The vendors have been moved to one central location.  Across the street from Boss’s Rock Shop.  Made FPS improvements that I hope will help.  Please let me know if you have any further issues with it.

notes.title: New update new stuff
notes.content:
Hey all ok so I have pushed a new update this update will fix the bug with the fur not changing as well it will add in the field guide for the age of the deer. There will be more to come with that guide but for now you have the age of your deer to help u choose the deer to kill. You can press G to bring it up and to close the guide. I made the inventory button so you can change the button yourself in game I tried working out escape but I have escape set in the code to cancel the bind when u are setting key binds so that is going to be more of a hassle to make happen the way I want. I recommend setting the key to TAB instead of I and change the lock on target to caps lock it don't really work right now and not sure if I will remove it yet so thats Y it is still there. So there is also a new music player so enjoy that you can bring it up by pressing P and close it with same button so now you can play music from any place u want if that's something you want. I also adding in new warm weather camo this camo is great for when you are hunting in warm weather. The full set ups your hunting skill and your stealth skills to 6+ so its worth buying at the shop. There is a camp for saving now as well as a bed in the house to manage saves. Be sure to go home and delete your save if u have one its very important. I hate to do that to yall but with the save system it just has to be that way sorry. I have a Ghost and a rouge bear on the map its not on the starting island. The bear is on the left side of the big island some place close to the park and the fields. Good luck finding it post a pic in discord when you find them I would like to know who has found it. The ghost gives treats so be on the look out for him there will be a few Halloween characters hidden around the map all threw Oct hope yall find and enjoy them they will all give u treats. They will lead us up to the Halloween event that will start the last week of Oct.

notes.content: Hello Conservationist this update is to fix the starter cabin so u can interact with the stuff on the table without zooming in. This will also add the story books to the map there is 6 of them right now they are all just hidden around but are labeled Part -1-6 each one has a name so you can hear them in order. I also added in the animal pens and the male and female fawns for the mule deer. Good luck al of you and watch for those snakes.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content:
Hello Conservationists..  First of all Thank You Thank You Thank You for your patience on this update..  As you open this update you will notice many many new changes and areas to explore and hunt.  I hope you will also notice an FPS increase..  The map has been my arch nemesis for quite some time BUT I think I got it.  I do ask that If you fall through the map after a save, please take note of the location and let me know.  That has been a major fight for me and if it is still not fixed then I will keep fighting.  Also we now have lootables in the game.. So if this is one of your favorite parts of a survival game.. go at it!  The harvestable foliage is still being worked on so stay tuned for that.  As always thank you for playing and your feed back.

One more thing to note if you fall threw after u load game like right at the start load it again in the menu it should put u on the landscape just a bug I noticed and a work around for it.

Also there is a cave that u can do some mining in and make some money to buy things. There is also 4 vendors around on the Island you start on

notes.title: Quick Vendor Patch
notes.content: This is a quick fix to take care of the vendors they all work fine now

notes.title: Patch to fix issues
notes.content: Hello Conservationists,  here is another update for you.  I have added some new gear.. You can now go to the vendor and buy yourself some rain gear and snow gear.  The camo  now has added stealth and hunting skills..  Each piece will add to it so get the whole set at once or a little at a time.  I adjusted the weather.  The cold no longer makes you hungry or thirsty but will affect stamina and fatigue.  Hot weather will affect hydration.  The axe and pick axe Should not break so easily.  Also added a tanning rack to dry hides so you can get more money from vendors.  Last but not least added a radio in the cabin so you can enjoy some hunting songs as you warm by the fire.

notes.title: Save Patch
notes.content: Hello Conservationists!   I DID IT!  All Inventory SAVES!!!  So you can now save your game with inventory and chests full.  So Play-Save-Load-Play again

notes.title: New update new stuff
notes.content: Hello all Conservationist,  Here is another update.  The last update I may have missed a few crucial pieces in the cabin.  That was my bad, I was testing a few things before I pushed the update.  This update there are a few things in the cabin for  you.  So first note the save system.  I am currently working hard on this as it is crucial for the game and I know it.  As of right now only the animals and placeable items are saving.  I adjusted how loud you are when you are crouched and walking so the deer won't hear you as easily.  I have added mushrooms and berries.  Some you can eat and some you can not.  These are still being worked on so what is safe now might not be safe later, so try one and see what it does to you. But I have a poison kit with you just in case.  I have also hidden a spot in the world but you will need to stop by the vendor for a pickax before looking for it.  There is a surprise in this location. Can you find it?

We would love to hear from the community on this one so shout out to us in steam.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content: So i added in a few things there is a journal to help tell u about some of the stuff in the game as well I have made a few new improvements to help with animal population I was having a issue with them no being on the map but showing up in the population. It was due to the breeding acting up pretty sure we have fixed this issue so you should see more animals now. There has been 2 new maps added they have not been fully tested but can be played on seem to be working on. 1 has beaver on it I am working with a little something with them so bare with me on this thanks to all that are playing the game I know it needs some work but I will get it there hang in there with me. I am gong to try to work on letting you guys play around with the game until I release so u can see how things are going.
